preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c_configuration WHERE name = 'self-service-support-phone-numbers'

column.name: description
column.value: Phone numbers mobile app (self-service) clients call for help, separated by commas, e.g. +256 774 067 967, +256 700 000 000. Shown when a login is refused (suspended, closed, locked) and added to the SMS and email sent when staff change a client's app access. When disabled or empty, clients are told to contact their branch.

column.name: text
column.value: Hello ${firstname} ${lastname}, ${accessChange} Reason: ${reason}. If you did not expect this change or need help, ${supportContact}.

update.where: name = 'SELF_SERVICE_ACCESS_CHANGED_EMAIL' AND text = 'Hello ${firstname} ${lastname}, ${accessChange} Reason: ${reason}. If you did not expect this change, please contact your branch.'
name = 'SELF_SERVICE_ACCESS_CHANGED_SMS' AND text = 'Hi ${firstname}, ${accessChange} Reason: ${reason}. Questions? Contact your branch.'
name = 'SELF_SERVICE_ACCESS_CHANGED_WHATSAPP' AND text = 'Hi ${firstname}, ${accessChange} Reason: ${reason}. Questions? Contact your branch.'
